title: P37 executable-opportunity hurdle: valid learning, staged liquidity, and legal-risk rebaseline

evidence.panel: data/normalized/etf_daily.parquet: 1,386,318 rows, 2,123 observed sessions, 1,378 tickers, 2018-01-02..2026-08-27. All probes intersected features with these observed sessions.
evidence.invalid_ml_history: ChampionTailRanker.fit passes list-of-lists and fractional label_rank to LightGBM 4.7.0. Reproduction raises TypeError('Data list can only be of ndarray or Sequence') and, after ndarray conversion, LightGBMError('label should be int type'). Both errors are swallowed into fallback-mean. Three measured OOS folds all used fallback-mean with zero feature importance while P35 promotion.json still reported artifact_integrity=true.
evidence.risk_contract_drift: The authoritative portfolio contract is [single=0.80, effective_gross=1.60, cash=0.05], but P27-P33 use [0.95,1.90,0.05]. Those artifacts are inadmissible as legal championship baselines.

direct_staged_oracle.method: Diagnostic foresight ceiling only: sponsor exact +1x/+2x ETF, actual opens, trailing ADV20, 1% daily participation, 3+5 bps costs, 0.80/1.60/0.05 limits, buys limited to first floor(36*0.25)=9 sessions.

evidence.model_probe: A valid four-threshold OOS classifier over 337,663 labels/2,006 dates produced overall P40=2.79%, P50=1.90%. Its latest fold reached P40=8.19%, P50=5.69% but ruin=8.01%. Direct selection is therefore not promotable without an OOF-calibrated incumbent hurdle.

assumptions_and_invariants: Full empirical completion means 2018-01-02..2026-08-27 over all 2,123 observed XKRX sessions; dates, folds, candidates, and the 36-session horizon may not be shortened.

Autonomous-category leverage remains UNKNOWN. Research evaluates aggressive (actual +1x/+2x) and conservative (actual +1x only) separately; live promotion is blocked until HTS manifest and leverage permission are verified.
Candidate and incumbent both use max single 0.80, max effective gross 1.60, min cash 0.05, identical actual ETF prices, costs, and participation.
Staged admission changes only scoring eligibility. Every buy and sell remains capped by configured daily ADV participation; no synthetic return multiplication or future liquidity is used.
P27 remains incumbent until valid-backend P37 passes every existing gate. Integrity repair or a higher foresight ceiling alone never promotes.

requirements: R1 Measurement: every training/oracle/baseline/promotion run uses resolve_session_grid(calendar sessions, normalized panel). Feature-only dates, missing-price sessions, and generic business days are excluded and reported.

R2 Legal baseline: remove or clamp P26-P33 overrides so every full_strategy_own comparison is <=0.80 single, <=1.60 effective gross, >=0.05 cash. Recompute full P27; prior 0.95/1.90 artifacts remain diagnostics only.

R3 Staged admission: FULL_TARGET behavior remains unchanged for existing models. STAGED_EXECUTION admits finite trailing ADV20 >= configs/universe.yaml min_adv_krw; transition_portfolio_state still caps every order. Missing ADV means no fill, never uncapped fill.

R4 Exact vehicles: executable_hurdle scores each PIT sponsor ETF with actual +1/+2 multiple as its own ticker, without pre-score family collapse, synthetic leverage, or 1x-to-2x mapping. TOP1 allocation preserves one family held.

R5 Eligibility: exclude inverse, synthetic, LOW-confidence multiplier, bad price, non-tradable, manifest miss, and unknown issuer. Conservative rules also exclude +2. Empty eligibility returns HOLD, never a legacy universe or forced CASH.

R6 PIT parity: features/universe/ADV use close(t), intent executes open(t+1), and labels replay exactly 36 observed sessions with actual opens/closes, CostConfig, sell-first ADV caps, cash, and exposure. Vectorized labels match transition_portfolio_state <=1e-10 on fixtures and <=1e-8 on 1,000 seeded production samples.

R7 Accumulation: target_weight=min(0.80,1.60/abs(multiple),0.95). New buys occur only for floor(horizon*0.25)=9 sessions, then HOLD. Missing owned-session prices carry marks per P36, never zero-value or free-fill.

R8 Valid learning: features are contiguous np.float64 and labels np.int32 before lgb.Dataset. TailGradeObjective maps strict exceedances to grades 0..N and label_gain=[0,cumulative scenario weights]. Any import, Dataset, train, prediction, or finite-value failure raises ChampionTrainingError; no fallback exists.

R9 Artifact truth: backend='lightgbm', non-empty version and hashes, trained_through before every evaluation date, and finite predictions are mandatory. Otherwise artifact_integrity=false and status=INVALID_ARTIFACT; fallback-mean artifacts invalidate on read.

R10 Hurdle: train four fold-local binary exceedance models from gates.yaml using exactly ml.champion_tail.executable_feature_columns. Derived PIT features are log_adv_20=log1p(ADV20), fill_sessions=target_notional/(ADV20*participation), and leverage_multiple from verified instrument metadata. Direct score is weighted probability sum; activation margin is direct-top minus the incumbent-selected ticker score. Missing incumbent score disables activation.

R11 OOF calibration: each outer fold derives activation records only from inner purged walk-forward predictions using the same 36 purge + 36 embargo. Search finite observed margins; require at least min_attainable_windows activations, ruin<=5%, and championship score>=legal incumbent. Tie-break by maximum uplift, lower ruin, then highest threshold. No valid threshold delegates every outer date to incumbent.

R12 Promotion: P37 stays RESEARCH_ONLY unless aggressive and conservative scenarios pass existing G1-G5, primary CI, LOYO, concentration, execution parity, zero gross violations, valid backend, ruin<=5%, and discordant power. UNKNOWN leverage or null manifest blocks live promotion.

R13 Evidence: artifacts record backend, hashes, legal limits, admission mode, fill budget, filled-weight distribution, fold thresholds, activation rate, discordant count, attainability/capture, and rejection reason as flat structured fields.

R14 Complexity: vectorize candidate extraction by date; label at most 64 decision dates per chunk with a 36-step NumPy state loop. No per-window whole-panel scans, repeated Parquet reads, or range truncation.

alternatives_considered: More P27 momentum/hold/inverse tuning: rejected after P36's roughly 75 variants and legal +2x oracle score 0.0505.
All high-liquidity 1x themes: rejected because the one-day-full-fill ceiling moves only 0.0505 to 0.0519.
Fix only the swallowed ranker exception: necessary but insufficient; valid direct grade/rank probes remained weak.
Use the valid weighted classifier unconditionally: rejected because its latest fold ruin is 8.01%.
Relax participation/exposure: rejected as financial infeasibility, not alpha.
Promote from oracle performance: rejected because the oracle contains future information.
design_rationale.chosen_reason: Exact-vehicle staged execution is the only measured opportunity-supply step change (+59% ceiling score). A valid multi-threshold learner plus OOF-calibrated incumbent hurdle targets that space only where it proves non-inferior under the ruin cap, while legal rebaselining and backend validation restore truthful evidence.
failure_modes: Training failure silently becomes a constant/ticker-order model with integrity=true.
A low-ADV winner receives immediate 80% notional despite a 1% daily ADV limit.
Outer-test or in-sample labels leak into activation calibration.
Candidate and incumbent use different or illegal exposure budgets.
Recent tail is promoted despite >5% ruin, LOYO concentration, unknown rules, or weak discordant power.

performance_budget.expected_data_scale: 1,386,318 rows, 2,123 sessions, 1,378 tickers; observed direct scope 337,663 labels over 2,006 dates and about 12.5M candidate-session state transitions.
performance_budget.storage_format: Existing zstd Parquet via PyArrow/Polars for labels and OOS scores; no CSV or external temp path.
performance_budget.dtype_precision: Float64 for prices, ADV, costs, weights, probabilities, PnL, compounding and gates; contiguous float64 features and int32 relevance grades.
performance_budget.chunking_strategy: Read each Parquet once, build date/ticker indices once, process 64 decision dates per label chunk, vectorize candidates across the fixed 36-step state loop, and stream chunks to project-local Parquet.
performance_budget.acceleration_candidate: NumPy vectorization first; evaluate compiled/JIT only if profiling shows the state kernel remains dominant, without reducing scope.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Strict exceedances become integer grades with cumulative championship gains.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_tail_grade_objective_maps_thresholds_to_integer_gain() -> None:
    import numpy as np
    from src.alpha.champion_ranker import TailGradeObjective

    objective = TailGradeObjective(thresholds=(0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60), weights=(0.10, 0.25, 0.45, 0.20))
    grades = objective.grade([0.30, 0.31, 0.41, 0.51, 0.61])

    assert grades.dtype == np.int32
    assert grades.tolist() == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert objective.label_gain == (0.0, 0.10, 0.35, 0.80, 1.0)

def test_champion_ranker_fails_closed_when_lightgbm_training_raises() -> None:
    from datetime import date
    from unittest.mock import patch
    import polars as pl
    import pytest
    from src.alpha.champion_ranker import ChampionTailRanker, ChampionTrainingError, TailGradeObjective

    train = pl.DataFrame({'decision_date': [date(2026, 1, 2)] * 2, 'source_ticker': ['A', 'B'], 'family_key': ['A', 'B'], 'mom_5': [0.1, 0.2], 'label_return': [0.2, 0.5]})
    objective = TailGradeObjective((0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60), (0.10, 0.25, 0.45, 0.20))

    with patch('lightgbm.train', side_effect=RuntimeError('backend failed')):
        with pytest.raises(ChampionTrainingError, match='backend failed'):
            ChampionTailRanker(('mom_5',), objective=objective, min_data_in_leaf=100).fit(train)

def test_direct_candidates_keep_exact_same_family_vehicles() -> None:
    from datetime import date
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    import polars as pl
    from src.alpha.champion_dataset import collect_direct_vehicle_candidates

    day = date(2026, 1, 5)
    panel = pl.DataFrame({'date': [day, day], 'ticker': ['ONE', 'TWO'], 'mom_5': [0.1, 0.2]})
    attrs = {ticker: SimpleNamespace(is_synthetic=False, confidence='HIGH', leverage_multiple=multiple, leverage_family_key='SAME') for ticker, multiple in [('ONE', 1), ('TWO', 2)]}
    universe = SimpleNamespace(get=lambda _day, _filters: SimpleNamespace(tickers=('ONE', 'TWO')))
    result = collect_direct_vehicle_candidates(panel, sessions=[day], universe=universe, filters=SimpleNamespace(), master=SimpleNamespace(attributes=attrs), feature_columns=('mom_5',))

    assert result.sort('source_ticker').get_column('source_ticker').to_list() == ['ONE', 'TWO']
    assert result.get_column('family_key').n_unique() == 1

def test_executable_label_limits_buys_to_horizon_fraction() -> None:

    assert label.tail_grade == 0

scenarios.expected_behavior: Inactive OOS dates preserve incumbent behavior.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_opportunity_model_delegates_to_incumbent_when_inactive() -> None:
    from datetime import date
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    import polars as pl
    from src.alpha.base import DecisionContext
    from src.alpha.champion_ranker import OosScoreStore
    from src.alpha.opportunity_hurdle import ExecutableOpportunityModel

    day = date(2026, 1, 5)
    store = OosScoreStore(pl.DataFrame({'decision_date': [day], 'source_ticker': ['DIRECT'], 'score': [0.9], 'activate': [False], 'is_evaluation': [True]}))
    incumbent = SimpleNamespace(score=lambda _snapshot, _context: {'P27': 1.0})
    model = ExecutableOpportunityModel(scores=store, incumbent=incumbent)
    context = DecisionContext(decision_date=day, regime=None, capital=1_000_000_000.0, held={}, rules=None)

    assert model.score(pl.DataFrame({'ticker': ['DIRECT', 'P27']}), context) == {'P27': 1.0}

acceptance: No artifact has integrity=true without an actual finite LightGBM fit; fallback-mean resolves INVALID_ARTIFACT.
P27/P37 artifacts both record [0.80,1.60,0.05], zero post-fill gross violations, 2,123 observed sessions, and identical next-open costs/participation.
Exact-ledger staged opportunity improves legal +2x championship ceiling by >=0.01 absolute and P40 attainability by >=25% relative; otherwise fitting stops HYPOTHESIS_REJECTED.
Activation uses inner OOF evidence only; null calibration delegates every date and cannot promote.
Live promotion requires full-range dual-scenario G1-G5/CI/LOYO/ruin/integrity/power PASS plus verified manifest and leverage rules; otherwise P27 remains incumbent and P37 RESEARCH_ONLY.
